ARABIC — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.

2. When practising Reading Aloud: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud: Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud: Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud: Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud: Fluency.

3. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

4. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

5. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.

7. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.

8. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud: Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading aloud: Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
